title: Chocolate Praline Brownies
description: Rich, gooey brownies made from a whole jar of Nutella, eggs and self-raising flour. Ready in minutes — the key is not to over-bake.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease and line a 25cm x 18cm baking tray.
Sift the flour into a bowl, crack in the eggs and mix well. Add the Nutella (holding back 1 heaped tablespoon) and stir until smooth.
Pour into the baking tray, spread with a spatula and bake for 25 minutes, until just set and starting to crack on top.
As the brownies cool, drizzle the remaining Nutella over the top (microwave for 10 seconds if too solid).
Slice into chunky squares or rectangles to serve.
notes: Makes 16. Per brownie estimate. Double the quantities in the same-sized tin for extra-fat squidgy brownies.
